description: This file defines a custom Gson TypeAdapter for serializing and deserializing the ExternalId class, handling JSON representation for ExternalId objects in a Fineract client.

classes.name: ExternalIdAdapter
classes.description: A Gson TypeAdapter for serializing and deserializing ExternalId objects, converting them to and from JSON values.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Serializes an ExternalId object to JSON, writing its value if not empty, or null otherwise.

methods.name: read
methods.description: Deserializes JSON input into an ExternalId object, setting it as empty or with value based on JSON null or string token.
